## Acceptance Criteria to Test Case Mapping

| AC ID | Acceptance Criterion | Test Cases Covering This AC | Coverage Status |
|-------|---------------------|----------------------------|-----------------|
| AC-1 | The user can access the "Create Process Order" Fiori app with an order type designated for rework. | TC-CS-053 | COVERED |
| AC-2 | The system only allows a rework order to be created against a batch with a documented QA disposition approving rework. | TC-CS-053, TC-CS-054, TC-CS-055, TC-CS-056 | COVERED |
| AC-3 | The rework order references the original batch and captures the approved rework procedure/recipe. | TC-CS-053, TC-CS-056, TC-CS-057, TC-CS-058, TC-CS-060, TC-CS-061 | COVERED |
| AC-4 | The system maintains full batch traceability linking the reworked batch to the original failed batch. | TC-CS-053 | COVERED |
| AC-5 | The reworked batch is subject to the same quality inspection and in-process control requirements as standard production. | TC-CS-053 | COVERED |
| AC-6 | The batch record for the reworked batch documents the original failure and the approved rework justification. | TC-CS-053, TC-CS-059 | COVERED |

**AC Traceability:** 6 of 6 ACs covered (100%)

## Test Execution Recommendations

**Execution Order:**
1. **Priority 1 — CRITICAL:** TC-CS-053 (HP-01) — Core business transaction must pass before other scenarios
2. **Priority 2 — HIGH:** TC-CS-054 through TC-CS-059 (NEG + ERR scenarios) — Regulatory controls and data integrity validations
3. **Priority 3 — MEDIUM:** TC-CS-060, TC-CS-061 (EDGE scenarios) — Boundary validations for data quality

**Execution Dependencies:** All test cases are independent; no sequential dependencies exist.

**Regression Testing:** All 9 test cases should be executed in every regression cycle for CRITICAL risk stories.

**Smoke Testing:** Execute TC-CS-053 (HP-01) as part of smoke test suite to validate core rework order creation functionality.
